text:
maria: Heads-up — seeing reconnect storms from a handful of EU customers when SSE responses send a late fragment (partial event body). Console shows a bunch of short-lived connections then a spike in reconnects.

devin: can you paste an example of the wire? is this chunking at proxy or client?

maria: snippet from edge logs (trimmed):
```
PROXY: recv chunk (len=12) id=abc123 partial=true
PROXY: forwarded to backend
PROXY: client rcvd keepalive ts=1617000000
PROXY: late fragment id=abc123 len=40
CLIENT: missed heartbeat -> reconnect
```

anya: hmm. looks like the client heartbeat timer treats the first small chunk as a complete event. late fragment resets state but client already reconnected. leads to double billing in console because resume path is counted as new session.

pm-jordan: how widespread is this? any correlation with route routing-policy=prefer-fast-proxy?

maria: only in eu-west so far, ~0.04% of streams last 24h but concentrated on long-lived chat sessions. route=fast-proxy and proxy version 2.4.3.

devin: is last-event-id preserved across resume? iirc our resume flow relies on Last-Event-ID header to dedupe. if proxy drops it or reorder fragments, resume may not be idempotent.

anya: checking code — proxy forwards Last-Event-ID but we have a path where partial fragments go through a different buffer that doesn't carry resume metadata. bug.

pm-jordan: SLO risk? users see flakiness right now?

sre-bot: alert: reconnect-rate for route fast-proxy eu-west > 5x baseline (last 30m).

ops-lee: can we add a metric tag for partial-fragment events? console charts only show reconnects and total sessions; need a breakdown to avoid chasing false positives.

devin: proposed fixes: 1) keep a 'stream-fragmented' tag in proxy telemetry when partial=true. 2) ensure Last-Event-ID and resume token are persisted in the fragment buffer path. 3) introduce a 150ms client-heartbeat-tolerance jitter on proxy to avoid racy reconns for very late bytes.

anya: +1 on tags. also we should avoid changing heartbeat tolerance on prod wide rollout — prefer a sticky canary for a day.

pm-jordan: agree. plan: canary in eu-west for 12h with metric gating. if reconnect delta <10% revert. add console annotation explaining potential false-double-billing.

maria: console UX ask: can we surface "partial-fragment" and "resume-deduped" in the per-route breakdown? ops-lee if we add tags that should be trivial.

ops-lee: yep. will wire tags into the console and add a short tooltip text: "partial-fragment: event arrived in multiple chunks; may trigger client reconnect depending on client implementation."

devin: implementation notes for engineers: patch in proxy branch 'v2/fragment-fix' will change ProxyFragmentBuffer to copy resume headers into fragment metadata. code snippet: 
```
// copy resume headers into fragment context
fragment.ctx.last_event_id = req.headers['Last-Event-ID'] || fragment.ctx.last_event_id
fragment.ctx.resume_token = req.headers['X-Resume-Token'] || fragment.ctx.resume_token
```

anya: also add unit test that simulates a late fragment and asserts no double-counted session in the resume path.

pm-jordan: timeline?

devin: can do branch PR today, run integration in staging, then canary in eu-west tomorrow morning.

maria: for immediate mitigation can we temporarily enable "resume-strict" fallback for affected customers? i.e., force resume to treat mismatch as non-fatal and rely on server-side dedupe to avoid new session charge.

ops-lee: we have a feature flag for resume-policy. I can flip it for the 3 tenants seeing the most impact.

pm-jordan: please do that now and post results in 1h. also add a console banner "Investigating transient SSE reconnects in eu-west — enabling resume-policy fallback for affected tenants".

maria: flipping flag now for customer ids: cust-42, cust-99, cust-314. will monitor.

sre-bot: notice: resume-policy fallback enabled for 3 tenants.

ops-lee: console changes PR in review: add partial-fragment timeseries (+ tooltip) and a select filter to correlate with per-route reconnects.

anya: follow-ups: - add sampling event with raw headers when partial fragment occurs (PII-free) - add integration test for sticky proxy buffer path - add telemetry alert that fires only when partial-fragment ratio > 1% and reconnect spike > 3x baseline.

devin: will handle the proxy patch and unit tests. anya, can you own the telemetry alert?

anya: yes. will also add a dashboard panel linking raw sample traces.

pm-jordan: thanks. update tickets and put a short blurb in the all-hands notes if we end up needing wider rollout changes.

maria: initial results after 30m: reconnect spike down ~65% for the flagged tenants. console shows fewer duplicate session counts. will keep monitoring and follow up with post-mortem if root cause remains in buffer implementation. :thumbsup:

ops-lee: leaving the feature flag enabled until patch canary is verified. schedule rollback window in 24h if metrics are stable.

sre-bot: end of thread: action items assigned -> devin (proxy patch), anya (telemetry + alert), ops-lee (console + flags), pm-jordan (comms).
